era: 1138 年生于科尔多瓦一个拉比世家——其祖上可溯至 Rabbi Yehuda Hanasi（《密西拿》编纂者）的宫廷——父迈蒙（Maimon）是其最早的《塔木德》教师——1148 年穆瓦希德王朝攻陷科尔多瓦，强令犹太人改宗或流亡，全家开始了长达十余年的颠沛流亡：先后避居阿尔梅里亚、休达，约 1159 年定居摩洛哥非斯（其间据后世争议性记载曾被迫表面改宗伊斯兰教）——1165 年经圣地巴勒斯坦短暂朝觐耶路撒冷（他立誓每年禁食纪念登临圣殿山之日）后定居埃及福斯塔特——以其弟大卫溺亡印度洋（约 1170 年，兄弟合营珠宝贸易、大卫是家中经济支柱）为转折，大病一场后转而以行医为业——凭医术先后成为法蒂玛/阿尤布宫廷御医（传统认为侍奉过维齐尔法迪勒，与萨拉丁朝廷有交集），据传萨拉丁本人曾邀其入侍而为其婉拒——同时被推举为埃及犹太社区的精神领袖（Nagid，约 1190 年代正式受任），以书信裁决从也门到马格里布的犹太律法争端，著名的《也门书信》安抚了受弥赛亚运动与迫害双重搅扰的也门社群——1168 至 1178 年间以十年之功完成《密西拿托拉》（Mishneh Torah）：把浩如烟海的《巴比伦塔木德》判决编纂为十四编、千余章的无引注法典——约 1185 至 1190 年用犹大-阿拉伯语（Judeo-Arabic）写成《迷途指津》（Dalalat al-Ha'irin / The Guide for the Perplexed），1204 年后由塞缪尔·伊本·提本译为希伯来文——1204 年逝世于福斯塔特/开罗，遗体运葬提比里亚——墓志铭云'从摩西到摩西，无人如摩西'——身后其十三信条被编入犹太祈祷书（Yigdal 颂），《迷途指津》引发延续数十年的'迈蒙尼德之争'（Maimonidean controversy），反对方焚烧其著作，而经院哲学的托马斯·阿奎那则直接吸收其'否定属性'学说
era_en: Born 1138 in Córdoba into a rabbinic family that traced itself to the court of Rabbi Yehuda Hanasi, editor of the Mishnah—his father Maimon was his first Talmud teacher—in 1148 the Almohads took Córdoba and forced Jews to convert or flee, and the family began more than a decade of wandering: Almería, Ceuta, and by about 1159 Fez in Morocco (where, according to a later and disputed account, they lived outwardly as converts to Islam)—in 1165, after a brief pilgrimage through the Holy Land (he vowed an annual fast for the day he ascended the Temple Mount), he settled in Fustat, Egypt—the drowning of his brother David in the Indian Ocean around 1170 (the two traded jewels, and David had been the family's support) broke his health and turned him to medicine—by his skill he became physician at the Fatimid/Ayyubid court (traditionally to the vizier al-Fadil, within Saladin's orbit), and is said to have declined an invitation to serve Saladin in person—at the same time he was recognized as the spiritual head (Nagid) of Egyptian Jewry, adjudicating halakhic disputes by letter from Yemen to the Maghreb, his famous Epistle to Yemen consoling a community shaken by persecution and a messianic agitation—between 1168 and 1178 he completed the Mishneh Torah: the vast Babylonian Talmud codified into fourteen books, over a thousand chapters, citation-free—about 1185–1190 he wrote The Guide for the Perplexed (Dalalat al-Ha'irin) in Judeo-Arabic, translated into Hebrew after 1204 by Samuel ibn Tibbon—he died at Fustat/Cairo in 1204 and was buried in Tiberias—his epitaph: 'From Moses to Moses, none arose like Moses'—his Thirteen Principles entered the Jewish prayer book (the Yigdal hymn); the Guide ignited a Maimonidean controversy lasting decades, in which opponents burned his works while Thomas Aquinas absorbed his doctrine of negative attributes into scholastic philosophy
school: 犹太律法系统化（halakhic codification）的集大成者（《密西拿托拉》十四编法典）/ 犹太哲学亚里士多德化的完成者（《迷途指津》以理性哲学重释托拉）/ '否定神学'在亚伯拉罕传统中的经典立法者（上帝只有否定属性）/ 犹太教十三信条的制定者（首次为犹太信仰立教义清单）/ 中世纪医学伦理与养生学的著述家（《养生法》《格言》的作者）
historical_significance: 迈蒙尼德（Moses ben Maimon, 1138-1204），中世纪最伟大的犹太哲学家、律法学家、医师与社区领袖，后世尊称 Rambam。他的历史地位由五件事锚定。其一，律法的总编纂：《密西拿托拉》把千万言的《塔木德》判决熔铸为结构分明的十四编法典，不注出处、不容歧义，使散落在辩论中的'活的律法'第一次拥有了可检索的总纲——它本身就是'从浩繁裁决到公理化法典'的方法论示范。其二，信仰的教义化：十三信条第一次为犹太教立下'最低共识'清单，把'何为必须相信'从无尽辩论中析出，Yigdal 颂至今在每个犹太会堂吟诵——'信仰清单'这一形式本身是他首创的方法论装置。其三，《迷途指津》的哲学重释：以亚里士多德哲学系统重释托拉，处理'律法语言与科学理性相冲突时诚实的智识人如何自处'——为'迷失在托拉字面与哲学真理之间的人'立法。其四，否定神学的经典表述：关于上帝我们只能说'祂不是什么'（非物体、非偶性、不可比拟），一切肯定属性皆是行为的转述或观念的类比——此说经译本传入拉丁世界，直接塑造了阿奎那的上帝论。其五，典范人格的建制：医师、法官、法典家、哲学家四位一体，'从摩西到摩西，无人如摩西'的墓志铭把其个人确立为流散犹太文明的制度性支柱。代价与极限：法典化被批评为扼杀塔木德式的开放辩论（卡罗《舒尔汉阿鲁赫》以同样体例反驳并最终取代其司法地位）；十三信条在其身后引发持久的正统性之争（哈西德·克雷斯卡斯为复活概念辩护、后世拉比否认信条的强制力）；《迷途指津》刻意晦涩（'以七种含义写作'），引发两个世纪解释权的混战，反迈蒙尼德派两度焚烧其著作。
historical_significance_en: Moses ben Maimon (Maimonides, Rambam, 1138-1204) was the greatest medieval Jewish philosopher, halakhist, physician and communal leader. Five achievements anchor his standing. First, the total codification of the law: the Mishneh Torah melted millions of words of Talmudic decision into a fourteen-book code, citation-free and deliberately univocal, giving the 'living law' scattered through debate its first searchable master plan—the work is itself a demonstration of method, from unbounded litigation to an axiomatic code. Second, the creedalization of faith: the Thirteen Principles were the first 'minimal consensus' list in Judaism, extracting 'what must be believed' from endless disputation; the Yigdal hymn is still sung in every synagogue—the very form of a 'creed list' is his invention. Third, the philosophical reinterpretation of the Guide for the Perplexed: Aristotelian philosophy brought into systematic contact with Torah, legislating for the honest intellectual caught between the law's language and scientific truth. Fourth, the classic statement of negative theology: of God we may say only what He is not (not a body, not an accident, incomparable); every positive attribute is a report of action or an analogy of ideas—transmitted into Latin through translation, it directly shaped Aquinas's doctrine of God. Fifth, the institution of the exemplary persona: physician, judge, codifier and philosopher in one body—the epitaph 'from Moses to Moses, none like Moses' fixed the man as an institutional pillar of the diaspora. Costs and limits: codification was attacked as strangling Talmudic open debate (Caro's Shulchan Arukh answered in the same genre and ultimately displaced his juridical primacy); the Thirteen Principles provoked a lasting controversy over orthodoxy (Hasdai Crescas defended resurrection against them; later rabbis denied their binding force); and the Guide, written in studied obscurity ('written in seven senses'), ignited two centuries of interpretive warfare, with opponents burning his works twice.
unique_thinking: 他思维方式的底色是'系统的总归拢与极限的诚实言说：真理若有体系就必须能被编纂成法典，而体系的顶端（上帝）恰恰是体系无法言说之物——思维的纪律是先归拢一切可归拢者，再在顶点处拒绝言说'。六个标志性动作。其一，'公理化归拢法'——把无边界的辩论海归拢为分编、分章、条目的封闭法典：先分类，再排序，再消除歧义，最后正文零引注（引注是辩论的遗迹，法典要的是裁决本身）。其二，'信条析出法'——从无尽神学争议中析出'最低共识'：任何争论必先问'这是核心信仰还是可争的边缘'，用编号清单把必须相信与可以讨论切开。其三，'否定的属性法'——对不可比拟者，肯定性言说必然使其沦为被造物；诚实路线只有否定：逐项说'祂不是什么'，逼近而不指认。其四，'寓言解码法'——圣典中与理性冲突的字面陈述必须读作寓言（'上帝的手'、'上帝后悔'），解码的钥匙由两条优先级决定：理性不可违背者按理性读，理性可违背者按字面读；一个陈述若字面可能，禁止寓言化。其五，'中间道路法'——德性与性情皆取两极之间的中道，唯谦卑一项例外（应取极端之低）；这条伦理几何学把'德的修养'变成对两个极端坐标的持续测量。其六，'双真分程法'——哲学理性与启示托拉各有管辖：哲学管辖'存在是什么'，托拉管辖'人该怎么活'；冲突处理先重读后协调，协调不成则守托拉而不弃理性。代价与极限：归拢式法典在结构上压制异议（卡罗的司法反扑与塔木德派的不满同源于此）；信条化把活信仰变成清单，其身后正统性战争证明清单本身就是争议源；《迷途指津》的自设密码使传播依赖解码授权，两派焚烧其书是密码传播模式的暴力终局。
unique_thinking_en: The bedrock of his thinking: total systematization joined to honest speech at the limit—if truth has a system it must be codifiable like a law code, yet the apex of the system (God) is precisely what the system cannot say; the discipline of thought is to gather all that can be gathered, then at the summit refuse to speak. Six signature moves. First, axiomatic gathering—reduce the boundless sea of debate to a closed code of books, chapters and entries: classify, order, disambiguate, and finally write with zero citations (citations are the residue of debate; a code wants the decision itself). Second, creedal extraction—from endless theological dispute extract the 'minimal consensus': before any argument, ask whether it touches a core belief or a contestable margin, and cut the must-believe from the debatable with a numbered list. Third, negative attributes—of the incomparable, affirmative speech demotes God to a creature; the honest route is negation: say item by item what He is not, approaching without pointing. Fourth, allegorical decoding—literal statements of scripture that clash with reason must be read as parables ('the hand of God,' 'God repented'), the decoding key fixed by a two-term priority: what reason cannot violate is read rationally, what it may violate is read literally; and a statement possible as literal must not be allegorized. Fifth, the middle way—virtue and temperament take the mean between two poles, with humility the single exception (the lower extreme is prescribed); this moral geometry turns cultivation of character into the continuous measurement of two extreme coordinates. Sixth, the double-truth division—reason and Torah each hold jurisdiction: philosophy governs 'what exists,' Torah governs 'how one shall live'; on conflict, reread first and harmonize second, and failing harmony, keep Torah without abandoning reason. Costs and limits: the gathering code structurally suppresses dissent (Caro's juridical counterattack and the Talmudists' discontent share this root); creedal listing turned living faith into a checklist, and the posthumous wars over orthodoxy prove the list itself is the controversy; the Guide's self-set cipher made transmission depend on licensed decoding—the two burnings of his books were the violent endgame of that ciphered circulation.

modes.domain_zh: 《密西拿托拉》的总方法。迈蒙尼德面对的知识工程问题是：巴比伦塔木德约二百五十万言，判决散落在数千页的正反辩论（shakla v-tarya）中，同一条律法的最终结论可能相隔数卷，一个普通学者终生无法通览。他的解法是四步归拢。第一步'分类'：把全部律法切分为十四编（知识、爱、时节、妇女、圣化、誓言、种子、圣事、洁净、损害、获取、民法、法庭、战争与王），编下设章、章下设条目——分类轴不是主题趣味而是'人的生命历程与义务对象'。第二步'排序'：每一条目自成闭环，从定义到细则到边界案例，读者从任何一条进入都不需要读过前面所有辩论。第三步'消歧'：同题异判必须给出单一裁决——他明确宣布'本部记录的是当前司法实践采纳的裁决'，辩论史被剥离出去。第四步'零引注'：正文不写'某贤说'、不写辩驳过程，只在个别关键处提示'此为我的个人判断'——法典呈现的是'活的律法'而非'律法的考古'。这一方法立即被推广到他自己的知识版图：十三信条是信条领域的同款归拢，《养生法》是医学的同款归拢。代价与极限：归拢在结构上压制异议——被剥离的辩论史恰恰是拉比传统的活力所在（同时代与后世的塔木德派批评其'越过了格玛拉'）；'当前采纳的裁决'的裁定权高度集中在他一人，未经验证的归拢有把个人判断永久化为公共标准的风险；卡罗《舒尔汉阿鲁赫》以同样体例完成归拢并附引注，恰恰是对'零引注'的反向修正。
modes.domain_en: The master method of the Mishneh Torah. Maimonides faced a knowledge-engineering problem: the Babylonian Talmud runs to some two and a half million words, its decisions scattered through thousands of pages of dialectical give-and-take (shakla v-tarya), the final ruling on a single law possibly volumes away from its beginning—no ordinary scholar could survey it in a lifetime. His solution has four moves. First, classification: cut the whole law into fourteen books (Knowledge, Love, Seasons, Women, Holiness, Utterances, Seeds, Divine Service, Purity, Damages, Acquisition, Civil Law, Judges, Wars and Kings), books into chapters, chapters into entries—the axis of classification is not topical taste but 'the course of a human life and the objects of its duties.' Second, ordering: each entry closes on itself, from definition through rules to borderline cases, so a reader entering anywhere need not have read all prior debate. Third, disambiguation: where authorities diverge, a single ruling must be given—he declares that 'this work records the decision adopted in current judicial practice,' stripping out the history of debate. Fourth, zero citations: the body says no 'so-and-so said,' no dialectic, and marks in rare key places 'this is my own judgment'—the code presents the living law, not the archaeology of the law. He immediately extended the method across his own map of knowledge: the Thirteen Principles are the same gathering in the field of creed, the Regimen of Health the same in medicine. Costs and limits: gathering structurally suppresses dissent—the excised history of debate is precisely where rabbinic vitality lives (contemporaries and later Talmudists reproached him for 'leapfrogging the Gemara'); the power to decide 'the ruling currently adopted' concentrates in one man, and an unvetted gathering risks fixing private judgment as public standard; Caro's Shulchan Arukh gathered in the same genre but restored citations—an exact reversal of the zero-citation rule.
modes.definition_zh: 知识系统化方法论/四步归拢：分类（按生命历程与义务对象切分）、排序（条目自成闭环）、消歧（同题异判给出单一裁决）、零引注（剥离辩论史，呈现活的律法而非律法的考古）
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-systematization methodology/four-step gathering: classification (cut by life-course and objects of duty), ordering (entries self-contained), disambiguation (one ruling per contested case), zero citations (excise the history of debate—present the living law, not its archaeology)

modes.key_quote_en: Let the reader take from this work the upshot of the whole oral law without dredging the ocean of debate—this code carries no citations, for citations belong to debate, and this book belongs to the ruling.
process_zh: 划定领域并选轴：把要归拢的知识域整体圈出，选一条贯穿全部材料的主轴（生命历程、义务对象、决策阶段），拒绝按材料原貌的偶然结构归档
四步归拢：分类切分到自然层级→每个单元排序为闭环（定义→细则→边界案例）→同题异判裁定唯一结论→剥离论证史只留结论
加装'单义条款'：对每一条裁决标注其权威级别（共识/多数/个人判断），把归拢者的裁定权显式化而非隐蔽化
预留更新接口：明示'若出现更强证据，此条可改'——法典的封闭性只封闭呈现形式，不封闭修正通道
process_en: Bound the domain and choose the axis: circle the whole field of knowledge to be gathered, choose one axis that runs through all the material (life-course, objects of duty, decision stages), and refuse to archive by the accidental shape of the sources

Gather in four steps: classify into natural tiers→order each unit as a closed loop (definition→rules→borderline cases)→adjudicate divergent authorities to one conclusion→excise the argumentation, keep only the ruling
Install the univocity clause: mark each ruling's authority grade (consensus/majority/private judgment), making the gatherer's adjudicating power explicit rather than hidden
Leave an update interface: state that 'on stronger evidence this entry may be revised'—the code's closure closes the form of presentation, not the channel of correction

十三信条作为信条领域的同款归拢：从无尽神学争议中析出编号的最低共识清单
《养生法》：把体液医学与个人体质、气候、起居归拢为可执行的宫廷医嘱——医学的同款四步法
representative_cases_en: The architecture of the Mishneh Torah: two and a half million words of Talmud melted into fourteen books, a thousand chapters—a searchable code executable from any single entry
The Thirteen Principles as the same gathering in the field of creed: a numbered minimal-consensus list extracted from endless theological dispute
The Regimen of Health: humoral medicine, constitution, climate and habit gathered into executable court medical instructions—the four steps applied to medicine
modern_applications_zh: 组织知识库建设：把散落在会议记录、邮件、口头惯例中的决策归拢为结构化手册——分类选轴、条目闭环、消除'我们一般都这么办'式的多义性，并标注每条规则的权威级别
大型代码库/运维手册的重构：从'考古式文档'（满是历史讨论与作废方案）改写为'裁决式文档'——正文只呈现当前有效结论，讨论史移入变更日志
标准与合规文件的编写：同题异判处必须裁定唯一结论并显式标注'此为公司裁决，非行业共识'，防止归拢者的个人判断伪装成客观标准
modern_applications_en: Organizational knowledge bases: gather decisions scattered through meeting notes, email and oral custom into a structured manual—choose the axis, close each entry, eliminate 'we usually do it this way' ambiguity, and mark each rule's authority grade

Refactoring large codebases and runbooks: rewrite 'archaeological documentation' (full of dead discussion and deprecated plans) as 'ruling-style documentation'—the body presents only current valid conclusions; the history moves to a changelog

Writing standards and compliance documents: where authorities diverge, adjudicate a single conclusion and label it explicitly 'a company ruling, not an industry consensus,' so the gatherer's private judgment cannot masquerade as objective standard

name_zh: 共识工程方法论/从无尽争议中析出'最低共识'的编号清单：任何争论先问'这是核心信仰还是可争的边缘'，用必须相信与可以讨论的切分终止无休止的分歧
name_en: consensus-engineering methodology/extract from endless dispute a numbered 'minimal consensus' list: before any argument ask whether it touches a core belief or a contestable margin—cutting the must-believe from the debatable to end interminable division
category: 共识工程方法论/从无尽争议中析出'最低共识'的编号清单：任何争论先问'这是核心信仰还是可争的边缘'，用必须相信与可以讨论的切分终止无休止的分歧
modes.domain_zh: 《密西拿评注》'论改宗'章的核心方法。迈蒙尼德面对的共同体问题是：犹太教千年来没有教义清单，何为核心、何为可争全凭口传氛围——一个改宗者面对无穷的拉比争论将无从下手，而'如何才算犹太人'这一生死攸关的问题（在穆瓦希德迫害的背景下是字面意义的生死）竟没有明确答案。他的解法是把'信仰'本身法典化：十三信条，从上帝的存在、独一与非物体，到先知的真理性、托拉的不可更改，到弥赛亚的来临与死人复活。方法的工艺要点有三。其一，'编号'：逐条编号使每一条可以被单独引用、辩护、攻击——争议从弥漫的氛围变成可定位的对象。其二，'最低'：清单只收'拒绝任何一条即出局'的核心，其余全部留给合法争辩——信条不是'全部真理'而是'共同体存续的最小公约数'。其三，'两类裁决'：内部争议（复活论等）用论辩解决，外部攻击（异教质疑）用辩护解决——不同来源的争议适用不同工具。此法使一个被三次大流散打散的共同体第一次拥有了明确的身份边界。代价与极限：清单本身就是争议源——克雷斯卡斯为复活概念辩护而攻击信条表述，后世拉比争论信条是否具有信经的强制力，'哪些是核心'的元争议恰恰无法被清单自身裁决；且最低共识有收窄效应：不在清单上的议题会被误读为'不重要'，而清单上的议题会被误读为'已定案'。
modes.domain_en: The core method of the 'Perek Helek' commentary on Mishnah Sanhedrin. Maimonides faced a communal problem: Judaism had for a millennium kept no creed list—what was core and what contestable lived only in the atmosphere of oral tradition; a convert facing the endless rabbinic debates had no purchase, and the existential question 'what makes one a Jew' (literally life-or-death under the Almohad persecutions) had no explicit answer. His solution: codify faith itself—thirteen principles, from God's existence, unity and incorporeality, through the truth of prophecy and the immutability of Torah, to the coming of the Messiah and resurrection of the dead. Three craft points. First, numbering: enumerated items can each be cited, defended, attacked individually—dispute turns from pervasive atmosphere into locatable objects. Second, minimality: the list admits only what expels—denial of any one principle puts one outside the covenant; everything else remains lawfully debatable—the creed is not 'the whole truth' but the community's minimal common denominator for survival. Third, two kinds of adjudication: internal disputes (on resurrection) are settled by argument, external attacks (pagan objections) by apologetics—disputes of different provenance take different instruments. The method gave a community scattered by three great exiles its first explicit identity boundary. Costs and limits: the list is itself the controversy—Crescas defended resurrection while attacking the principles' formulation; later rabbis disputed whether the principles carry credal binding force; and the meta-dispute over 'what counts as core' cannot be settled by the list itself; further, minimal consensus has a narrowing effect—issues off the list are misread as unimportant, issues on it as already settled.
modes.definition_zh: 共识工程方法论/把'必须相信什么'从争议海中析出为编号的最低共识清单：逐条编号使争议可定位、只收'拒绝即出局'的核心、按争议来源（内部论辩/外部辩护）选用不同裁决工具
modes.definition_en: Consensus-engineering methodology/extract 'what must be believed' from the sea of dispute into a numbered minimal-consensus list: numbering makes each dispute locatable, minimality admits only what expels, and the source of a dispute (internal argument vs. external apologetics) selects the instrument of adjudication
modes.source_chapter: 《密西拿评注》圣化卷'论改宗'章（Perek Helek）卷首长篇导论；《密西拿托拉》知识编'托拉基础'章的教义化重述
key_concepts: 最低共识 minimal consensus（拒绝任一条即出局的信仰核心清单）
编号争议 locatable dispute（从弥漫氛围到可逐条引用的对象）
身份边界 identity boundary（共同体存续的最小公约数）
两类裁决 two adjudications（内部争议用论辩、外部攻击用辩护）

modes.key_quote_zh: 凡对这十三条中任何一条心存怀疑者，即已出离共同体——但在清单之外，争论是自由的。
modes.key_quote_en: Whoever doubts any one of these thirteen has left the covenant—yet beyond the list, argument remains free.
process_zh: 盘点争议并分类：把领域内全部长期争议列出，按'拒绝其结论是否威胁共同体存续'分为核心与边缘两类
逐条编号并最小化：核心条目写成编号清单，每条表述到'可以被单独攻击'的精度；边缘议题明示'不在清单上，可以争论'
按来源选工具：内部争议准备论辩（用共同体自己的权威说话），外部攻击准备辩护（用对方可接受的共同前提说话），两套工具分开维护
设元规则防收窄：明示清单是'存续的最小公约数'而非'真理的全部'，并预留清单本身的修订程序——防止最低共识被误读为封闭教条
process_en: Inventory and classify disputes: list every long-running controversy in the field, dividing core from margin by the test 'does rejecting its conclusion threaten the community's survival'

Number and minimize: write the core items as a numbered list, each phrased to the precision of 'individually attackable'; state explicitly that everything else 'lies outside the list and may be argued'

Match instrument to source: for internal disputes prepare argument (speaking with the community's own authorities), for external attacks apologetics (speaking from premises the opponent accepts); maintain the two toolkits separately

Install the meta-rule against narrowing: declare the list 'the minimal common denominator of survival, not the whole of truth,' and provide a procedure for revising the list itself—so minimal consensus is not misread as closed dogma
representative_cases_zh: 十三信条的诞生：改宗者与被迫改宗者的'何为核心'问题被一纸编号清单终裁——Yigdal 颂由此进入每个会堂的礼拜
《也门书信》的安抚工程：也门社群因弥赛亚运动与迫害动摇，迈蒙尼德以信条框架（先知真理性、弥赛亚信条）诊断并稳定信仰
死后复活的辩护：在《论复活》书信中他把'复活是否核心'从信条争议降格为措辞争议——展示'清单之内'与'清单措辞'的层级区分
representative_cases_en: The birth of the Thirteen Principles: the convert's and forced-convert's question 'what is core' settled by a numbered list—the Yigdal hymn entered every synagogue as its echo

The consolation engineering of the Epistle to Yemen: a community shaken by a messianic agitation and persecution diagnosed and steadied with the creedal frame (truth of prophecy, the Messiah principle)
The Treatise on Resurrection: he demoted 'is resurrection core' from a creedal dispute to a dispute over wording—demonstrating the layering of 'inside the list' and 'the list's phrasing'
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目的治理章程：从社区无穷争论中析出'贡献者不可逾越的行为底线'编号清单，并明示清单之外议题可以自由争论——防止治理讨论永久循环
组织的'原则清单'设计：把价值观从墙上标语改写为'违反即出局的少数条目+其余可辩'——用最小公约数保护身份，而非用大全景扼杀分歧
跨文化谈判的议题分级：谈判前把全部议题按'破裂级/可让步级'编号，破裂级单独锁定，可让步级开放交换——避免把核心让渡给气氛
modern_applications_en: Governance charters for open-source projects: extract from endless community dispute a numbered list of non-crossable bottom lines for contributors, declaring everything beyond the list freely arguable—ending permanent governance loops

Designing organizational 'principles lists': rewrite wall-slogan values as 'the few items whose violation expels + everything else debatable'—protecting identity with a minimal common denominator rather than killing dissent with a panorama

Issue-grading in cross-cultural negotiation: number all issues as rupture-grade or concession-grade before bargaining, lock the rupture-grade separately, and open the concession-grade for exchange—so the core is never traded to atmosphere

name_zh: 极限言说方法论/关于不可比拟者只能否定地言说：肯定属性必使其沦为被造物，逐项说'祂不是什么'逼近而不指认——'存在'是唯一的可说肯定，且仍是歧义的
name_en: methodology of speech at the limit/of the incomparable one can speak only negatively: affirmative attributes demote God to a creature; say item by item what He is not, approaching without pointing—'existence' is the one sayable positive, and even it is equivocal
category: 极限言说方法论/关于不可比拟者只能否定地言说：肯定属性必使其沦为被造物，逐项说'祂不是什么'逼近而不指认——'存在'是唯一的可说肯定，且仍是歧义的
modes.domain_zh: 《迷途指津》第一部第 50-60 章的核心方法。迈蒙尼德面对的言说问题是：托拉与祈祷书中充满'上帝是伟大的、仁慈的、智慧的'等肯定谓词，而理性已证明上帝非物质、无偶性、不可分类——若肯定属性照字面理解，上帝就被拉入被造物的范畴表（凡有属性者即是复合体，复合体即非独一，即非上帝）。他的解法是给宗教语言立一条总规则：一切关于上帝的肯定言说只允许三种用途。其一，'行为属性'——'上帝是仁慈的'是祂 creations 的转述（祂的作为显得仁慈），不是祂本性的陈述；其二，'观念类比'——'上帝是智慧的'是把被造的智慧观念指向上，提示类比方向而非同质共享；其三，'否定属性'——唯一诚实的方式是说'祂不是物质、不是偶性、不是可朽的、不是可 comparabile 的'——每一次否定排除一个误认，排除完毕'剩下的那个不可排除者'即是方向，但它本身不可被言说。'存在'是唯一的准例外，且须读作绝对歧义的（与被造物的存在只是同词不同义）。此法使'上帝的不可言说'从神秘主义的感叹变成一条可执行的语言纪律，并与《迷途指津》的寓言解码法（M-MAI-004）配合：凡是与理性冲突的字面肯定，要么读寓言，要么读否定。代价与极限：纯粹否定使'敬拜什么'变得悬空——礼拜的对象被说得越精确越错，实践虔诚与理论神学的裂缝由此制度化；且否定清单无法完成（无穷多的'不是'仍不能唯一确定'是'），批评者可指其为系统化的不可知论——迈蒙尼德承认'人的认识在祂面前止步'，但止步处正是信仰的位置，这一安排被双方阵营（神秘主义者与理性主义者）各自挪用。
modes.domain_en: The core method of Guide I.50-60. Maimonides faced a problem of speech: Torah and the liturgy are full of positive predicates—'God is great, merciful, wise'—while reason has proved God non-material, without accidents, unclassifiable; if affirmative attributes are read literally, God is dragged into the category-tables of creatures (whatever has attributes is composite, the composite is not one, and so not God). His solution: one master rule for religious language, admitting only three uses of positive speech about God. First, attributes of action—'God is merciful' reports His creations (His works appear merciful), not His essence. Second, analogical attribution—'God is wise' points the created idea of wisdom upward, signaling the direction of analogy, not shared essence. Third, negative attributes—the only honest mode: 'not a body, not an accident, not perishable, not comparable'; each negation excludes one misidentification, and when the exclusions are complete, 'what cannot be excluded' is the direction—unsayable itself. 'Existence' is the one quasi-exception, and must be read as absolutely equivocal (the same word, a different meaning from created existence). The rule turns 'the ineffability of God' from a mystic's sigh into an executable language-discipline, paired with the allegorical decoding of the Guide (M-MAI-004): every literal positive clashing with reason is read either as parable or as negation. Costs and limits: pure negation leaves 'what is being worshipped' suspended—the more precisely the object of worship is described, the more surely it errs, institutionalizing the gap between lived piety and theoretical theology; and the list of negations cannot be completed (infinite 'is nots' still fail to fix a unique 'is'), inviting the charge of systematized agnosticism—Maimonides concedes 'human knowledge halts before Him,' but the halting place is precisely the station of faith, an arrangement both camps, mystics and rationalists, each appropriated.
modes.definition_zh: 极限言说方法论/给宗教语言立总规则：肯定言说只许三种用途（行为转述、观念类比、否定逼近），逐项说'祂不是什么'排除误认——排除完毕剩下的不可排除者即方向，但不可被言说
modes.definition_en: Methodology of speech at the limit/one master rule for religious language: positive speech only as report-of-action, analogical attribution, or negation—say item by item what He is not to exclude misidentifications; the unexcludable remainder is the direction, itself unsayable
modes.source_chapter: 《迷途指津》第一部第 50-60 章论属性；《密西拿托拉》知识编'托拉基础'第 1-3 章的非物体化表述；'论改宗'章对属性问题的先行论述

行为属性 attributes of action（把'上帝仁慈'读作创造的转述而非本性）
观念类比 analogical attribution（被造观念的向上指引，非同质共享）
绝对歧义的'存在' absolutely equivocal 'existence'（唯一的准肯定，同词不同义）
不可比拟 incomparability（凡被指认者即被范畴化，范畴化即降格）
modes.key_quote_zh: 关于祂，否定的言说是接近，肯定的言说却是远离——你每说出一个肯定的谓词，你就把祂变成了一个别的东西。
modes.key_quote_en: Of Him, negative speech draws near and affirmative speech recedes—with every positive predicate you utter, you turn Him into something else.
process_zh: 先立'不可指认者'：确认讨论对象属于'肯定描述必然降格'的类型（绝对、终极、不可比拟者）——此后一切语言操作在此约束下进行
审计既有语言：把领域内全部肯定陈述分类——哪些是行为转述、哪些是观念类比、哪些是必须改正的字面误认
逐项否定排除：对每一候选'理解'说'不是这个'——排除创造神、可感物、复合体、可比较者，每次排除一个误认
守住剩余者：排除完毕后明确宣布'剩下的不可被言说'——把不可言说本身写为体系的一条正式结论而非失败标记
process_en: First fix 'the unpointable-at': confirm the object belongs to the type where affirmative description necessarily demotes (the absolute, the ultimate, the incomparable)—all speech-operations proceed under this constraint
Audit the existing language: classify every affirmative statement in the field—reports of action, analogical attributions, or literal misidentifications to be corrected
Exclude by successive negation: say 'not this' of each candidate understanding—exclude creator-god, sensible object, composite, comparable being, one misidentification per negation
Hold the remainder: when the exclusions are complete, declare that 'what remains cannot be said'—writing unsayability as a formal conclusion of the system, not a mark of failure
representative_cases_zh: 《迷途指津》第一部的属性论：把'上帝仁慈'改读为'祂的作为显得仁慈'——宗教语言的三用途总规则由此立法
《密西拿托拉》开篇的改写：传统祈祷语言被改写为'祂不是物体、没有形象'的非物体化表述——法典对否定纪律的吸收
对'上帝后悔''上帝之手'的处理：凡与'非物质'冲突的字面肯定一律读寓言或读否定——否定法与寓言法的配合
representative_cases_en: The attribute theory of Guide Part I: 'God is merciful' reread as 'His works appear merciful'—the three-use rule for religious language legislated
The rewriting at the head of the Mishneh Torah: traditional liturgical language recast as incorporeal statement ('He is not a body, has no image')—the code absorbing the negative discipline
The treatment of 'God repented' and 'the hand of God': every literal positive clashing with incorporeality read as parable or negation—the negative method in harness with the allegorical
modern_applications_zh: 写作者对'终极概念'的纪律：对'美''意义''智能'这类不可指认者，用'它不是 X'的排除法逼近，而非堆砌正面形容词——每多一个肯定谓词反而多一分误认
AI 对齐与安全研究中的概念界定：对'对齐'这类终极目标，先立'不可指认'约束，再逐项否定'对齐不是什么'（不是合规、不是无害输出、不是服从）——防止目标被指认即被钻空
产品与战略的'方向性表述'：对组织愿景等不可操作化之物，用'我们不是什么'的排除表述替代空洞的肯定口号，保留不可言说的方向感同时给出可执行的边界
modern_applications_en: A writer's discipline for 'ultimate concepts': approach the unpointable-at (beauty, meaning, intelligence) by excluding what it is not rather than piling up positive adjectives—every added predicate adds a misidentification

Concept definition in AI alignment and safety: for an ultimate target like 'alignment,' first fix the unpointable-at constraint, then exclude item by item what alignment is not (not compliance, not harmless output, not obedience)—so a pinned target cannot be gamed

Directional language for products and strategy: for the unoperationalizable (organizational vision), replace hollow positive slogans with exclusions of 'what we are not'—keeping the sense of unsayable direction while giving an executable boundary

name_zh: 文本调和方法论/圣典字面与理性冲突时的受控解码规程：理性不可违背者按理性读、可违背者按字面读，字面可能者禁止寓言化——解码是被许可的最后手段而非默认操作
name_en: textual-reconciliation methodology/a controlled decoding protocol for scripture's clash with reason: what reason cannot violate is read rationally, what it may violate literally, and what is possible literally must not be allegorized—decoding is a licensed last resort, not the default
category: 文本调和方法论/圣典字面与理性冲突时的受控解码规程：理性不可违背者按理性读、可违背者按字面读，字面可能者禁止寓言化——解码是被许可的最后手段而非默认操作
modes.domain_zh: 《迷途指津》全书的方法枢纽。迈蒙尼德面对的文本问题是：托拉中'上帝有手、有怒、后悔、行走'这类拟人陈述，与理性已确立的非物体结论直接冲突；而若把一切麻烦经文都寓言化，托拉的权威将变成解释者的橡皮图章——'寓言化'失控的先例（伊本·鲁世德对律法的寓言化、卡拉派与拉比派的解释战）就在眼前。他的解法是给解码装上两道闸门。第一道闸门'冲突检测'：只有当字面解读与'理性已证明者'（上帝非物质、无物体、无情感扰动）或'感官已观察者'发生不可调和的冲突时，才启动解码——'上帝的怒'是冲突案例（怒是情感扰动，属物质性），'上帝说过话'不是（语言事件不必然预设物体）。第二道闸门'字面优先'：若一个陈述字面上可能，则禁止寓言化——'红海分开'字面可能，故按字面读，即使有寓言层也不作为裁决依据。第三道闸门'排序解码'：解码的钥匙不是解释者偏好而是两条优先级——先理性原则后文本细节，先整体教义后孤立字句。他还有一个隐蔽的读者分层理论：《迷途指津》'以七种含义写作'——表层给大众，深层给受过训练者，缺陷经文（缺陷表述）是为'智识人看破'而设的陷阱式陈述。代价与极限：'理性已证明者'的清单依赖其亚里士多德主义——亚里士多德宇宙论（天体不灭、永恒运动）后来被证伪，按其原则本应寓言化的经文反而要按字面读，规则陷入自我反噬；'字面可能'的标准模糊，给解释权留下争议空间；而'七种含义'的密码化写作使《迷途指津》本身成为解释战的战场（迈蒙尼德之争的导火索）。
modes.domain_en: The pivotal method of the Guide. Maimonides faced a textual problem: anthropomorphic statements in Torah—God has hands, wrath, regret, walks—clash directly with reason's established incorporeality; yet if every troublesome verse is allegorized, Torah's authority becomes the interpreter's rubber stamp—the runaway precedents (Ibn Rushd's allegorizing of law, the Karaite-rabbanite wars of interpretation) were before his eyes. His solution: two gates on decoding. Gate one, conflict detection: decoding opens only when the literal reading collides irreconcilably with 'what reason has proved' (God non-material, without body, without emotional perturbation) or 'what the senses have observed'—'the wrath of God' is a conflict case (wrath is perturbation, and perturbation is material), while 'God spoke' is not (a speech event need not presuppose a body). Gate two, literal priority: if a statement is possible literally, allegorizing is forbidden—the Red Sea split is literally possible, so it is read literally, and even if an allegorical layer exists it is not the basis of ruling. Gate three, ordered decoding: the key is not the interpreter's taste but a fixed priority—reason's principles before textual detail, whole doctrine before isolated words. Beneath these lies his hidden reader-stratification theory: the Guide 'is written in seven senses'—a surface for the many, a depth for the trained, with deliberately defective statements set as traps for the discerning intellectual. Costs and limits: the list of 'what reason has proved' depends on his Aristotelianism—when Aristotelian cosmology (incorruptibility of the heavens, eternal motion) was later falsified, verses his rules would allegorize had to be read literally, and the rule rebounded on itself; 'literally possible' is a fuzzy standard, leaving interpretive authority contestable; and the ciphered seven-fold writing made the Guide itself a battlefield of interpretation—the fuse of the Maimonidean controversy.
modes.definition_zh: 文本调和方法论/三道闸门的受控解码：冲突检测（字面与理性/感官不可调和才启动）→字面优先（字面可能者禁止寓言化）→排序解码（理性原则先于文本细节、整体教义先于孤立字句）
modes.definition_en: Textual-reconciliation methodology/three-gate controlled decoding: conflict detection (open only on irreconcilable clash with reason or the senses)→literal priority (what is possible literally must not be allegorized)→ordered decoding (reason's principles before textual detail, whole doctrine before isolated words)

modes.key_quote_en: The Torah speaks in the language of men—yet to read 'the hand of God' as a hand demotes the Most High, and to allegorize what is possible literally turns Torah into a rubber stamp.
process_zh: 列出'不可动摇者'：先写死理性已确立者与感官已观察者的清单——这是解码程序中唯一的硬约束，也是全部闸门的地基
冲突检测：逐条比对文本字面义与不可动摇清单——冲突则进入解码通道，无冲突则字面放行，永不预支寓言
按优先级解码：冲突案例按固定优先级重读——理性原则先于字句、整体教义先于孤立文本，解码产物必须回写进整体教义自洽
给解码留审计痕迹：每个寓言化决策标注其依据（理性原则/感官观察）与反例边界（字面可能性为何不成立）——使解码可被质疑而非解释者独断
process_en: List the unshakables: write down first what reason has proved and what the senses have observed—the single hard constraint of the decoding program and the ground of all gates
Detect conflict: compare each text's literal sense with the unshakable list—conflict enters the decoding channel, no conflict passes literally; allegory is never prepaid
Decode by priority: conflict cases are reread by fixed priority—reason's principles before words, whole doctrine before isolated text—and the decoding product must write back into doctrinal coherence

Leave an audit trail: mark each allegorical decision with its ground (rational principle / sensory observation) and the boundary of counterexamples (why literal possibility fails)—so decoding is contestable, not the interpreter's fiat
representative_cases_zh: 拟人经文的逐条清洗：《迷途指津》第一部把'上帝之手''上帝之怒''上帝后悔'逐条解码为行为属性或寓言——受控解码的全面示范
伊甸园叙事的哲学解码：亚当夏娃被解码为'人类理智的寓言'（知善恶即理性觉醒）——整段叙事回写进'理智—身体'教义自洽
'七种含义'的分层设计：《迷途指津》表层与深层并行——同一文本对大众给虔诚、对智识人给哲学，解码权按训练分层授权
representative_cases_en: The cleansing of the anthropomorphisms: Guide Part I decodes 'the hand of God,' 'the wrath of God,' 'God repented' item by item into attributes of action or parable—a full demonstration of controlled decoding

The philosophical decoding of the Eden narrative: Adam and Eve decoded as 'a parable of human intellect' (knowing good and evil as the awakening of reason)—the whole narrative written back into intellect-body doctrinal coherence

The stratified design of 'seven senses': the Guide's surface and depth run in parallel—the same text gives piety to the many and philosophy to the trained, decoding authority licensed by level of training
modern_applications_zh: 宪法与成文法的司法解释纪律：字面可能者按字面执行，'活宪法'式寓言化只在字面与后续修正案/科学事实不可调和时启动——把解释权从法官偏好收回到受控规程
组织章程/合同的修订解释：当文本与既定不可动摇原则（公司宪法、行业标准）冲突时启动受控重读，并留审计痕迹标注解码依据——防止'弹性解释'成为橡皮图章
经典文本的现代教学：先立'不可动摇者'（科学已确立者），逐条检测经典陈述冲突与否，冲突者按优先级解码并标注依据——教学生受控解读而非任意寓言化
modern_applications_en: Interpretive discipline for constitutional and statutory law: the literally possible is executed literally, 'living constitution' allegorizing opens only when the literal clashes irreconcilably with later amendments or established fact—recovering interpretive authority from judicial taste into controlled protocol

Interpreting revisions of charters and contracts: when text clashes with established unshakable principles (a corporate constitution, an industry standard), open controlled rereading and leave an audit trail of the decoding ground—so elastic interpretation cannot become a rubber stamp

Teaching classic texts in the modern classroom: fix the unshakables (what science has established), test each classical statement for conflict, decode the conflicting ones by priority with grounds marked—teaching controlled reading, not arbitrary allegorizing

name_zh: 德性几何学方法论/把每项德性与性情定位为两个极端之间的可测中点：唯谦卑例外（取极端之低）——德的修养被改写为对两极坐标的持续测量与回调
name_en: moral-geometry methodology/position each virtue and temperament as a measurable midpoint between two extremes, with humility the single exception (the lower extreme prescribed)—cultivation rewritten as the continuous measurement and correction of two polar coordinates
category: 德性几何学方法论/把每项德性与性情定位为两个极端之间的可测中点：唯谦卑例外（取极端之低）——德的修养被改写为对两极坐标的持续测量与回调
modes.domain_zh: 《密西拿托拉》'德性篇'（Hilkhot De'ot）第一章的方法。迈蒙尼德把希腊伦理学（亚里士多德的中道说）法典化为犹太律法：'人的性情（如怒、勇、贪、逸）不是被造时的固定判决，而是后天养成的行为倾向——而倾向可以被重复训练改写'。此判断是整个方法的引擎：既然性情是倾向而非本质，德性就不是'拥有'而是'定位'——每项性情处在两极之间的某一点上（暴怒/麻木之间是温怒的适度；挥霍/吝啬之间是慷慨；鲁莽/怯懦之间是勇气），修养的任务是把坐标持续调回中点。方法的关键工艺特性有三。其一，'可测性'：中点不是模糊的'适度感'而是可操作的参照——'怒'的中点是'仅在重大应怒之事上怒且可被劝回'，有行为判据可自我检验。其二，'训练路径'：初学者若在中点难稳，可先刻意走向对立极（对吝啬者教其挥霍式施予数月再回调）——以过冲换回稳。其三，'例外条款'：谦卑是唯一被命令取极端的德——人应'把谦卑修到极低'；愤怒则是唯一'任何量的增加都应避免'的性情。代价与极限：中点清单依赖其亚里士多德框架，换一个性情分类学（如现代心理学的大五人格）坐标即失效；'过冲训练'对某些失败模式（成瘾、暴怒）反而危险——现代行为科学不支持'以毒攻毒'的普适性；且'把谦卑修到极低'在实践上难与自我贬抑区分——迈蒙尼德用'为修谦而谦'与'自视无价值'的区分来防，但界线依赖判断。
modes.domain_en: The method of Hilkhot De'ot chapter one of the Mishneh Torah. Maimonides codified Greek ethics (Aristotle's mean) into Jewish law: 'a man's temperaments—anger, boldness, greed, indolence—are not a fixed verdict of creation but acquired dispositions of conduct, and dispositions can be rewritten by repeated practice.' That judgment is the engine of the method: since temperament is disposition and not essence, virtue is not something one 'has' but a position one takes—every temperament stands somewhere between two poles (temperate mildness between rage and numbness; generosity between profligacy and miserliness; courage between recklessness and cowardice), and cultivation is the continuous task of moving the coordinate back to the midpoint. Three craft properties. First, measurability: the midpoint is not a vague 'sense of moderation' but an operational reference—the mean of anger is 'anger only on a great matter warranting it, and capable of being talked back down'—a behavioral test one can run on oneself. Second, the training path: a beginner who cannot hold the midpoint may deliberately overshoot to the opposite pole (teaching the miser months of profligate giving, then correcting back)—trading overshoot for stability. Third, the exception clause: humility is the one virtue commanded at the extreme—one should 'cultivate humility to the utmost low'; anger is the one temperament whose every increment should be avoided. Costs and limits: the list of midpoints hangs on the Aristotelian frame—redivided by another taxonomy of temperament (say, the modern Big Five), the coordinates fail; overshoot training is dangerous for certain failure modes (addiction, rage), and modern behavioral science does not support fighting fire with fire as universal; and 'cultivating humility to the utmost low' is in practice hard to distinguish from self-abasement—Maimonides guards with the distinction between humility-for-cultivation and self-assessment-as-worthless, but the boundary depends on judgment.
modes.definition_zh: 德性几何学方法论/性情是后天倾向而非被造判决——每项性情定位为两极间可测中点，修养即持续测量与回调；初学者可过冲训练换回稳；谦卑是唯一取极端的例外
modes.definition_en: Moral-geometry methodology/temperament is acquired disposition, not creation's verdict—each temperament is a measurable midpoint between poles, and cultivation is continuous measurement and correction; beginners may overshoot to the opposite pole for stability; humility is the single extreme-prescribed exception
modes.source_chapter: 《密西拿托拉》知识编'德性篇'第一章论性情与中道；同篇末章论'把谦卑修到极低'与怒的全量禁绝
key_concepts: 性情的可训练性 the tractability of temperament（倾向而非本质，重复可改写）
中点坐标 the midpoint coordinate（有行为判据的可测参照）
过冲训练 overshoot training（初学者以对立极换回稳）
谦卑例外 the humility exception（唯一被命令取极端的德）
怒的全量禁绝 the total ban on anger（唯一任何增量都应避免的性情）
modes.key_quote_zh: 性情人皆有之，方向各异——智者的功课是让自己的每一项性情都稳稳站在中点，唯有谦卑，要走到最低的那一端去。
modes.key_quote_en: Every man has temperaments, each tending a different way—the wise man's work is to hold every temperament steady at its midpoint; humility alone must be walked to the lowest end.
process_zh: 拒绝'本质判决'：把待改的性情从'我就是这种人'改写为'我目前站在某两极之间的某点'——先消解身份化，再谈调整
定位两极并写判据：为该性情找出两端，把中点写成可自我检验的行为判据（'在什么情境、以多大强度、能否被劝回'）
选择训练路径：中点难稳者用过冲训练（刻意走向对立极一段时期再回调）；每个训练周期末以判据复测坐标
执行例外条款：对谦卑类目标直接取极端（修到极低），对愤怒类目标执行零容忍（任何增量都改）——两条特殊规程不适用中点逻辑
process_en: Refuse the verdict of essence: rewrite the temperament to be changed from 'this is what I am' to 'I currently stand at some point between two poles'—dissolve identity-fixation before adjustment
Fix the poles and write the test: find both extremes, and phrase the midpoint as a behavioral test one can run on oneself (in what situations, at what intensity, capable of being talked back down)

Choose the training path: if the midpoint cannot be held, use overshoot training (deliberately toward the opposite pole for a period, then correct back); re-measure the coordinate against the test at each cycle's end

Execute the exception clauses: for humility-type targets take the extreme directly (to the utmost low); for anger-type targets enforce zero tolerance (every increment corrected)—two special protocols outside the midpoint logic
representative_cases_zh: '德性篇'开篇的立法：性情被宣布为可训练的倾向——希腊中道说被法典化为犹太律法的第一条德性条款
愤怒的特殊条款：'德性篇'把怒判为'任何量都应避免'的性情——中点几何学内的单点否决
对吝啬者的训练建议：先教其挥霍式施予数月、再回调至慷慨——过冲换回稳的可操作示范
representative_cases_en: The legislation opening Hilkhot De'ot: temperament declared trainable disposition—Greek doctrine of the mean codified as the first clause of Jewish virtue law
The special clause on anger: anger judged 'a temperament whose every quantity should be avoided'—a single-point veto inside the midpoint geometry
The training advice for the miser: months of profligate giving, then correction back to generosity—an operational demonstration of overshoot-for-stability
modern_applications_zh: 行为习惯的坐标化管理：把'我要少发火'改写为'怒的中点判据'（何情境可怒、多大强度、能否被劝回）并每周复测——把模糊的'自我改善'变成坐标测量
领导力的性格调校：对'过于强势/过于回避'的领导者，先定位两极与中点判据，难稳者用过冲训练（刻意授权数周再回调）——避免'变得温和'这种无法测量的目标
谈判与沟通训练：把'果断'定位在'鲁莽/怯懦'之间并写行为判据（多快决策、可否被新证据劝回），训练者按判据复测而非凭感觉评'是否果断'
modern_applications_en: Coordinate management of behavioral habits: rewrite 'I will lose my temper less' as the midpoint test for anger (in which situations, at what intensity, capable of being talked back down), re-measured weekly—turning vague self-improvement into coordinate measurement

Character calibration in leadership: for the over-assertive or over-avoidant leader, fix poles and midpoint test first; where stability is hard, use overshoot training (deliberately delegating for weeks, then correcting)—avoiding the unmeasurable goal of 'becoming gentler'

Negotiation and communication training: position 'decisiveness' between recklessness and timidity with a written behavioral test (how fast a decision, whether new evidence can talk it back), with trainers re-measuring against the test rather than feeling for 'decisiveness'

name_zh: 管辖权划分方法论/给理性与启示各立管辖：哲学管辖'存在是什么'、托拉管辖'人该怎么活'——冲突先重读后协调，协调不成则守托拉而不弃理性
name_en: jurisdiction-partition methodology/give reason and revelation separate jurisdictions: philosophy governs 'what exists,' Torah governs 'how one shall live'—on conflict reread first and harmonize second; failing harmony, keep Torah without abandoning reason
category: 管辖权划分方法论/给理性与启示各立管辖：哲学管辖'存在是什么'、托拉管辖'人该怎么活'——冲突先重读后协调，协调不成则守托拉而不弃理性
modes.domain_zh: 《迷途指津》的整体架构所依托的方法。迈蒙尼德面对的秩序问题是：亚里士多德哲学（永恒宇宙、天体理智）与托拉（创世、奇迹）在多处不可调和——而'抛弃理性'将使宗教沦为蒙昧，'抛弃托拉'将使共同体解体。他的解法不是在每场冲突中裁决谁对，而是先立管辖权地图：哲学的管辖是'理智可及的存在'（自然、宇宙论、灵魂的能力），托拉的管辖是'人的应然生活'（诫命、伦理、敬拜秩序）；两域在逻辑上并非对等——哲学结论若被证明，托拉的字面陈述必须重读（M-MAI-004），而托拉诫命的权威不因哲学结论而动摇。冲突处理的固定程序：第一步重读（是否误读了字面/误用了理性），第二步协调（寻找既不歪曲文本也不歪曲理性的第三义），第三步'双重归档'（协调不成则把冲突登记为'人类的理智在此止步'——实践上守托拉，理论上不强行裁决）。要点是'双重归档'不是骑墙：他明确说在不可裁决处，'宁信理性证明而重读文本，不因文本字面而弃证明'，但诫命层永远按托拉执行。代价与极限：'管辖权地图'依赖'两域不重叠'的假设，而实际上哲学触及的宇宙论结论（永恒宇宙）恰恰是托拉叙事的根基（创世）——这一处他本人的处理（认为'永恒说未被证明，故托拉创世说暂时胜出'）暴露了地图的接缝；后世'双重真理论'（拉丁阿维罗伊主义）把管辖分离推向'两真并存'，被教会判为异端，说明分程方案在制度上极易滑坡；且'不可裁决处守托拉'在多管辖并存的时代（如医学与安息日的冲突）需要逐案裁决，系统性不足。
modes.domain_en: The method underlying the whole architecture of the Guide. Maimonides faced a problem of order: Aristotelian philosophy (eternal cosmos, intelligences of the spheres) and Torah (creation, miracles) clash irreconcilably at many points—yet abandoning reason would reduce religion to obscurantism, and abandoning Torah would dissolve the community. His solution was not to adjudicate each clash but first to draw a jurisdictional map: philosophy's jurisdiction is 'existence accessible to intellect' (nature, cosmology, the powers of the soul); Torah's is 'the life man ought to live' (commandments, ethics, the order of worship); the two domains are not logically equal—where philosophy's conclusions are proved, Torah's literal statements must be reread (M-MAI-004), while the authority of the commandments is untouched by philosophical results. A fixed procedure for conflict: first, rereading (was the literal misread or reason misapplied?); second, harmonizing (find a third sense distorting neither text nor reason); third, double-filing (failing harmony, register the conflict as 'human intellect halts here'—practically keep Torah, theoretically force no verdict). The point is that double-filing is not fence-sitting: he states explicitly that where the undecidable lies, 'one should rather trust a rational demonstration and reread the text than abandon the demonstration for the literal,' while the commandment-layer is always executed per Torah. Costs and limits: the jurisdictional map assumes the two domains do not overlap, yet philosophical cosmology (eternity of the world) strikes at the very root of Torah's narrative (creation)—his own handling there ('eternity is not proved, so Torah's creation account prevails for now') exposes the seam of the map; later 'double-truth theory' (Latin Averroism) pushed the partition toward 'two truths side by side' and was condemned as heresy, showing how easily the scheme slides institutionally; and 'keep Torah where undecidable' needs case-by-case ruling wherever jurisdictions overlap (medicine and the Sabbath), with no general system.
modes.definition_zh: 管辖权划分方法论/先立管辖权地图再处理冲突：哲学管辖'存在'、托拉管辖'应然'——冲突走固定三步（重读→协调→双重归档），双重归档非骑墙：理性证明优先于字面，诫命层永远按托拉执行
modes.definition_en: Jurisdiction-partition methodology/draw the jurisdictional map before handling conflicts: philosophy governs 'existence,' Torah governs 'the ought'—conflicts follow a fixed three steps (reread→harmonize→double-file); double-filing is not fence-sitting: rational demonstration outranks the literal, while the commandment-layer is always executed per Torah
modes.source_chapter: 《迷途指津》第一部导论与第二部论创世的冲突处理；致提本的信论全书目的；《密西拿托拉》知识编'偶像崇拜法'开篇论理性与诫命
key_concepts: 管辖权地图 the jurisdictional map（存在归哲学、应然归托拉的先划界）
固定三步 the fixed three steps（重读→协调→双重归档的冲突规程）
双重归档 double-filing（不可裁决处'理智止步'的正式登记）
证明优先 priority of demonstration（理性证明优先于字面重读）
诫命不可让 the inalienable commandments（应然层不因哲学结论动摇）
modes.key_quote_zh: 理智与托拉不是两个对手——它们分治两个国度；唯有在边界上相撞时，让证明先说话，让诫命照常执行。
modes.key_quote_en: Intellect and Torah are not two adversaries—they govern two realms; only when they collide at the border, let the demonstration speak first and the commandment stand in force as always.
process_zh: 先画管辖权地图：在处理任何具体冲突前，先明确两个权威各管什么（事实层归理性、应然层归托拉/制度底线），禁止在冲突现场临时划界
固定三步处理：冲突案例先重读（误读/误用检测）→再协调（找两不歪曲的第三义）→不成则双重归档（登记'不可裁决'并按实践权威执行）
给两域设权重规则：在可裁决处理性证明优先于字面文本；在应然层，托拉/制度权威不因事实结论动摇——权重规则本身写死，不逐案摇摆
预防滑坡：明示'双重归档'与'两真并存'的区别——归档是暂缓裁决并保留唯一实践标准，不是承认两套互斥真理都真
process_en: Draw the jurisdictional map first: before any concrete conflict, fix what each authority governs (fact-layer to reason, ought-layer to Torah / institutional baseline), forbidding boundary-drawing on the spot
Process by the fixed three steps: reread (checking misreading and misapplication)→harmonize (a third sense distorting neither)→double-file (register 'undecidable' and act on the practical authority)

Set weighting rules for the two domains: where decidable, rational demonstration outranks the literal; in the ought-layer, the authority of Torah/institutions is untouched by factual conclusions—the weighting rules are fixed, not case-by-case

Guard against the slide: state the difference between double-filing and 'two truths side by side'—filing defers the verdict while keeping one practical standard; it does not concede that two mutually exclusive truths are both true
representative_cases_zh: 《迷途指津》对创世与永恒的处理：宇宙永恒说'未被证明'故暂按托拉创世读——分程法在地图接缝处的真实运转
对'上帝后悔'类文本的裁决链：理性证明（非物质）优先于字面→字面被重读为寓言——证明优先规则的实战示范
行医与安息日的裁决：救护与诫命的冲突按诫命让位于生命（pikuach nefesh）执行——应然层内部的权威排序
representative_cases_en: The Guide's handling of creation and eternity: the doctrine of an eternal cosmos 'not proved,' so creation read per Torah for now—the division working at the seam of its own map
The ruling chain for texts like 'God repented': rational demonstration (incorporeality) outranks the literal→the literal reread as parable—the priority-of-demonstration rule in action
Medicine and the Sabbath: conflicts of care and commandment executed by the rule that life suspends the Sabbath (pikuach nefesh)—authority-ordering inside the ought-layer
modern_applications_zh: 科学与宗教/文化传统的机构治理：先立管辖权地图（事实层归研究、伦理层归共同体章程），冲突走固定三步并双重归档——避免每场争议都变成总体战
技术伦理委员会的裁决规程：对'技术可能性与制度底线'冲突（如基因编辑），先重读条款是否误读→再协调（新表述两不歪曲）→不成则按底线执行并登记待决——权重规则事先写死
跨学科团队的分工冲突：事实研究岗与合规/伦理岗各管一层，冲突不现场互相否决，走'重读→协调→按实践权威执行+登记待决'——防止总体化内耗
modern_applications_en: Institutional governance where science meets religion or cultural tradition: draw the jurisdictional map first (fact-layer to research, ethics-layer to community charter), process conflicts by the fixed three steps with double-filing—keeping every dispute from becoming total war

Ruling protocols for technology-ethics boards: on conflicts of 'technical possibility vs. institutional baseline' (say, gene editing), reread the clauses for misreading first→harmonize (a formulation distorting neither)→failing that, act on the baseline and register the open question—weighting rules fixed in advance

Division-of-labor conflicts in interdisciplinary teams: research posts and compliance/ethics posts each govern a layer; conflicts are not live mutual vetoes but run 'reread→harmonize→act on the practical authority + register'—preventing totalizing attrition

name_zh: 专业实践方法论/把诊疗建立在观察、体质与可检验的养生推理上：先记录个体变量（体质、气候、起居、情绪），再按理性框架推断并开出可执行处方，同时服从专业管辖（行医不因安息日中止）
name_en: professional-practice methodology/base diagnosis on observation, constitution and testable regimen reasoning: record individual variables first (constitution, climate, habit, mood), then infer within a rational frame and prescribe executable orders—while honoring professional jurisdiction (medicine does not pause for the Sabbath)
category: 专业实践方法论/把诊疗建立在观察、体质与可检验的养生推理上：先记录个体变量（体质、气候、起居、情绪），再按理性框架推断并开出可执行处方，同时服从专业管辖（行医不因安息日中止）
modes.domain_zh: 《养生法》《论痔疮》与《格言》所承载的方法。迈蒙尼德是宫廷医师，服务对象（维齐尔法迪勒）的性命与他的行医声誉系于每一次处方。他的诊疗方法有三个与法典、哲学共享的标志性特征。其一，'个体变量先行'：开篇即要求医师记录病人的体质（冷热干湿）、居住气候、年龄、职业、起居节律与情绪状态——处方不是针对'病名'而是针对'这个变量组合'，同一疾病在不同变量组合下处方相反。其二，'养生优先于药'：整套诊疗的重心在可执行的日常规则（饮食量、睡眠时点、运动类型、情绪管理——他明确把'情绪过激'列为致病变量并开出心理处方），药物是养生失守后的干预而非默认手段——预防被写为优先级最高的一档。其三，'管辖权服从'：医师执业受伦理总则约束——他的著名格言'愿在我心中只装对病人的怜悯'（流传甚广的'迈蒙尼德日祷'虽系后世托名，但其职业伦理与他自己的表述一致）；且行医不因安息日中止（pikuach nefesh 的专业层应用）——专业义务高于宗教仪式义务。这套方法使他成为中世纪把'个体化处方＋预防优先＋职业伦理'三者打包的典范。代价与极限：其医学理论以盖伦体液说为框架，框架本身已被证伪——方法的可迁移部分是'变量记录与可执行处方'的形式工艺，而非其生理学内容；且宫廷医师的处境使其处方天然向强者倾斜（服务权力者的医学伦理始终有结构性问题）；'情绪致病'的洞见在当时缺乏任何可检验机制，只能作为箴言传承。
modes.domain_en: The method carried by the Regimen of Health, the Treatise on Hemorrhoids and the Aphorisms. Maimonides was a court physician whose patron's life (the vizier al-Fadil) and whose own medical reputation hung on every prescription. His diagnostic method shares three signature features with his code and philosophy. First, individual variables first: he opens by requiring the physician to record the patient's constitution (hot-cold, wet-dry), climate of dwelling, age, occupation, rhythm of daily life and state of mind—the prescription targets not 'the disease name' but 'this combination of variables'; the same disease under different combinations takes opposite prescriptions. Second, regimen before drugs: the weight of the whole practice lies in executable daily rules (quantity of food, timing of sleep, type of exercise, management of the passions—he lists 'excess of emotion' among pathogenic variables and prescribes for it psychologically); drugs are the intervention after regimen fails, not the default—prevention is written as the top priority tier. Third, subordination to jurisdiction: the physician's practice is bound by an ethical code—his famous maxim 'may only compassion for the patient fill my heart' (the widely circulated 'Prayer of Maimonides' is a later attribution, but its professional ethic agrees with his own statements); and medicine does not pause for the Sabbath (the professional application of pikuach nefesh)—professional duty outranks ritual duty. The method made him the medieval model of packaging 'individualized prescription + prevention first + professional ethics.' Costs and limits: his medical theory runs on Galenic humoralism, a framework since falsified—what transfers is the formal craft of variable-recording and executable prescription, not the physiology; and the court-physician position tilts prescriptions toward the strong (the ethics of medicine serving power carries a structural problem throughout); the insight 'the passions sicken' had no testable mechanism in his time and could pass on only as maxim.
modes.definition_zh: 专业实践方法论/诊疗三特征：个体变量先行（处方针对变量组合而非病名）、养生优先于药（预防为最高档，药物是干预而非默认）、管辖权服从（职业伦理高于仪式义务，行医不因安息日中止）
modes.definition_en: Professional-practice methodology/three features of diagnosis: individual variables first (prescriptions target variable-combinations, not disease names), regimen before drugs (prevention the top tier; drugs the intervention, not the default), subordination to jurisdiction (professional ethics outrank ritual; medicine does not pause for the Sabbath)
modes.source_chapter: 《养生法》开篇论个体变量与气候；《论哮喘》《论痔疮》的个体化处方；《密西拿评注》论 pikuach nefesh；《格言》的医学伦理条款
key_concepts: 个体变量先行 individual variables first（体质、气候、起居、情绪的记录清单）
养生优先 regimen before drugs（预防为最高档的优先级结构）
情绪变量 the passions as variables（把心理状态写进生理处方的先行者）
pikuach nefesh（生命高于仪式的专业层应用）

modes.key_quote_zh: 同一疾病在不同的人身上是不同的病——医师的功课是先记下这个人的体质、气候与起居，再谈药石。
modes.key_quote_en: The same disease in different persons is a different disease—the physician's work is to write down first this person's constitution, climate and habits, and only then speak of drugs.
process_zh: 先记录变量清单：对每一个案建立个体变量档案（体质、年龄、气候、职业、起居节律、情绪状态），拒绝直接对'病名'开方
按变量组合推断：在理性框架内推断该变量组合下的干预方向——同一诊断在不同组合下允许相反处方，处方必须可执行到日常动作
按优先级排序干预：养生（饮食/睡眠/运动/情绪）为第一档，药物为养生失守后的第二档——预防写在治疗方案的最前面
执行管辖权服从：专业义务的边界由伦理总则（生命优先、怜悯优先）裁定——仪式与程序义务不得中止专业响应
process_en: Record the variable list first: build an individual variable file for every case (constitution, age, climate, occupation, daily rhythm, state of mind), refusing to prescribe off the disease name

Infer by variable-combination: within the rational frame infer the direction of intervention for this combination—the same diagnosis may take opposite prescriptions under different combinations, and prescriptions must be executable down to daily actions
Rank interventions by priority: regimen (food, sleep, exercise, passions) as the first tier, drugs as the second after regimen fails—prevention written at the head of the treatment plan

Execute subordination to jurisdiction: the bounds of professional duty are set by the ethical code (life first, compassion first)—ritual and procedural obligations may never suspend the professional response
representative_cases_zh: 《养生法》为维齐尔法迪勒而作：开篇即用一整章记录法迪勒的体质、气候与起居——'个体变量先行'的完整示范
把'情绪过激'列为致病变量并开心理处方（情绪管理规则）——中世纪医学把心理变量写入生理处方的先行案例
安息日行医的裁决传统：pikuach nefesh 使生命救护优先于一切仪式——管辖权服从在专业层的应用
representative_cases_en: The Regimen of Health written for the vizier al-Fadil: an entire opening chapter recording al-Fadil's constitution, climate and habits—the full demonstration of 'individual variables first'

Listing 'excess of the passions' among pathogenic variables and prescribing for it psychologically (rules of emotion management)—a medieval precedent of writing psychological variables into physiological prescriptions
The ruling tradition of practicing on the Sabbath: pikuach nefesh makes rescue of life outrank all ritual—the professional application of subordination to jurisdiction
modern_applications_zh: 临床与健康的个体化实践：建立'变量档案先行'的诊疗/教练流程（体质、环境、作息、情绪先记录，方案后开），并把生活方式干预排在药物/技术干预之前——预防优先的结构
专业服务的伦理管辖：给高价值客户（权力、资本）服务的顾问/医师建立'伦理总则高于客户意愿'的明文边界——防止专业判断被强者倾斜
复杂系统的'变量组合诊断'：运维/安全/管理问题不按'故障名'处理，先记录系统变量组合（负载、气候般的部署环境、人员节律），同症不同因允许相反修法
modern_applications_en: Individualized practice in clinical and health work: build the 'variable-file first' workflow (constitution, environment, sleep, mood recorded before any plan is issued), with lifestyle intervention ranked before drugs or technology—a prevention-first structure

Ethical jurisdiction in professional services: for consultants and physicians serving high-value clients (power, capital), a written boundary that 'the ethical code outranks the client's wishes'—keeping professional judgment from tilting toward the strong

Variable-combination diagnosis in complex systems: treat operations/security/management problems not by 'fault name' but after recording the system's variable combination (load, deployment climate, human rhythms); same symptom, different cause, opposite fix allowed

name_zh: 分布式治理方法论/以书面文书对无法到场的共同体行使权威：每封信自带'事实诊断—法理引据—行动指令'三段结构，且区分安抚型与裁决型两种文体——权威靠文书的可复制性而非肉身到场来执行
name_en: distributed-governance methodology/exercise authority over a community one cannot reach by written instrument: every letter carries a three-part structure (fact-diagnosis, legal grounding, action directive), with two registers distinguished—consoling and adjudicating; authority executed by the replicability of documents, not bodily presence
category: 分布式治理方法论/以书面文书对无法到场的共同体行使权威：每封信自带'事实诊断—法理引据—行动指令'三段结构，且区分安抚型与裁决型两种文体——权威靠文书的可复制性而非肉身到场来执行
modes.domain_zh: 《也门书信》《论改宗者书信》《论迫害》等书信群所承载的方法。迈蒙尼德治下的'埃及犹太社区精神领袖'职位是一个横跨地中海的分布式治理问题：也门社群在阿拉伯海之滨受迫害与弥赛亚运动双重搅扰，马格里布与黎凡特各有律法争端，领袖本人身在开罗、行医事繁、终生未能亲访任何一处。他的解法是把权威写成文书：来信提出问题，回信以固定三段结构执行裁决。第一段'事实诊断'：先复述并重估来件的处境（也门信先诊断'你们的苦难一半来自迫害、一半来自假弥赛亚的预言'）——诊断错误则后续全部失效，故此段最详。第二段'法理引据'：给出裁决所依赖的权威链（托拉、塔木德、信条），且引用到可以被当地学者复核的精度——文书由此可以被第三方检验，而不依赖'他说是这样'。第三段'行动指令'：给出可执行的具体行动（'停止追随预言者''以禁食与祈祷代替绝望'），并注明适用边界。两种文体的区分是方法的隐形骨架：安抚型（也门信）以诊断与共情开路、裁决放缓；裁决型（改宗者信）直接入法理——文体错配（对求安抚者下指令、对求裁决者施共情）会使文书失效。代价与极限：文书权威依赖'来信—回信'的通信网络，网络中断则治理中断；诊断依赖单方陈述（他看不到现场），文书可以被对方的呈现方式操纵；且书面裁决的复用性使早期文书的过时结论在后世被当作永久先例引用（他自己就曾抱怨后人把他针对特定情境的书信当作普遍教条）。
modes.domain_en: The method carried by the Epistle to Yemen, the Epistle on Conversion, On Persecution and the other letters. Maimonides's post as head of Egyptian Jewry posed a distributed-governance problem spanning the Mediterranean: the Yemenite community on the Arab Sea, shaken by persecution and a messianic agitation at once; legal disputes in the Maghreb and the Levant; the leader himself in Cairo, burdened by medicine, never able to visit any of them. His solution was to write authority as document: the question arrives by letter; the reply executes the ruling in a fixed three-part structure. Part one, fact-diagnosis: restate and re-estimate the situation first (the Yemen letter opens by diagnosing 'your suffering is half from persecution, half from the predictions of a false messiah')—if the diagnosis errs, everything after fails, so this part is the fullest. Part two, legal grounding: the chain of authorities the ruling rests on (Torah, Talmud, the principles), cited to a precision local scholars can verify—the document thus becomes checkable by third parties, not resting on 'he says so.' Part three, action directive: executable concrete steps ('follow no more the prophet-figure,' 'replace despair with fasting and prayer'), with the boundary of application marked. The distinction of two registers is the hidden skeleton of the method: the consoling register (to Yemen) opens with diagnosis and empathy and slows the ruling; the adjudicating register (on conversion) enters the law directly—a register mismatch (commands to one seeking consolation, consolation to one seeking a ruling) voids the document. Costs and limits: documentary authority depends on the letter-network; cut the network and governance halts; the diagnosis rests on one-sided statements (he never saw the scene), so the document can be gamed by how the other side frames the case; and the reusability of written rulings lets outdated conclusions of early letters be cited later as permanent precedent—Maimonides himself complained of later readers making his situation-specific letters into universal dogma.
modes.definition_zh: 分布式治理方法论/把权威写成文书：三段结构（事实诊断→法理引据→行动指令）+ 两种文体（安抚型缓裁决、裁决型直入法理）——诊断最详因其决定后续；引据须可被第三方复核；指令带适用边界
modes.definition_en: Distributed-governance methodology/write authority as document: three-part structure (fact-diagnosis→legal grounding→action directive) plus two registers (consoling slows the ruling; adjudicating enters the law directly)—the diagnosis fullest because everything after depends on it; grounding verifiable by third parties; directives carry boundaries of application
modes.source_chapter: 《也门书信》全文结构；《论改宗者书信》的裁决型示范；《论迫害》对被迫改宗者的法理处理；书信集首尾对其权威来源的自述
key_concepts: 三段结构 the three-part structure（诊断→引据→指令的文书骨架）
事实诊断 fact-diagnosis（处境重估先于一切裁决）
可复核引据 verifiable grounding（权威链引到第三方可检验的精度）
双文体 two registers（安抚型与裁决型的文体区分与错配禁忌）
文书权威 documentary authority（以可复制文书替代肉身到场的治理）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不能到你们那里去，但法理可以——让这封信带上诊断、引据与指令：诊断若错，引据无益；引据若不可复核，指令无权。
modes.key_quote_en: I cannot come to you, but the law can—let this letter carry diagnosis, grounding and directive: if the diagnosis errs the grounding profits nothing; if the grounding cannot be verified the directive holds no authority.
process_zh: 先诊断后裁决：对每一宗远程事务，先花最大篇幅复述并重估来件的处境与诉求——诊断段未写完前禁止进入裁决
把引据写到可复核精度：裁决所依赖的每条权威（条文、先例、信条）引用到当地执行者可以独立查验的程度——文书的质量=可被第三方检验
区分文体并防错配：判断来件是求安抚还是求裁决，选对应文体；安抚型先共情缓指令，裁决型直入法理少铺垫
给指令加边界与时限：行动指令写明适用条件与失效情形，并预防'情境文书被当永久教条'——文书的复用风险在发出时就要对冲
process_en: Diagnose before ruling: for every remote matter, spend the fullest space restating and re-estimating the situation and plea—no ruling may begin before the diagnosis is complete

Cite the grounding to verifiable precision: every authority the ruling rests on (text, precedent, principle) cited to the degree that local executors can independently check—the quality of the document = third-party checkability

Distinguish registers and prevent mismatch: judge whether the incoming letter seeks consolation or a ruling, and choose the register accordingly—consoling opens with empathy and slows the directive; adjudicating enters the law with little preamble

Bound and date the directive: state the conditions of application and the cases of expiry, guarding against 'the situation-specific letter becoming permanent dogma'—the reuse risk must be hedged at the moment of dispatch
representative_cases_zh: 《也门书信》：对受迫害与假弥赛亚双重搅扰的也门社群，先诊断'双重苦难'、再引先知权威、末给'禁食祈祷代替绝望'的指令——三段结构的最完整示范
《论改宗者书信》：对被迫改宗者的身份裁决直入法理（被迫的行为不算背教）——裁决型文体的标杆
对马格里布、黎凡特各地争端的书信群：同一框架在不同语境的批量复用——文书治理对肉身到场的替代
representative_cases_en: The Epistle to Yemen: for a community shaken by persecution and a false messiah at once—diagnosing the 'double suffering,' grounding in prophetic authority, closing with 'replace despair with fasting and prayer'—the fullest display of the three-part structure
The Epistle on Conversion: the identity ruling for forced converts entering the law directly (forced acts are not apostasy)—the benchmark of the adjudicating register
The letter-groups to the Maghreb and the Levant: the same frame reused across contexts in bulk—documentary governance substituting for bodily presence
modern_applications_zh: 远程团队的管理文书：对无法到场的分布式团队，重要决定写成三段文书（处境诊断→依据→带边界的指令），并按对方需求选'安抚型/裁决型'文体——杜绝'只下指令不做诊断'的失效管理
法务与合规的书面意见书：意见书的权威=引据可复核精度；给每条结论标注适用边界与失效条件，防止意见书被后人当万能条款引用
开源社区/论坛的仲裁与公告：置顶公告采用'诊断（当前冲突的真实结构）→依据（治理章程条款）→指令（带时限的行动）'三段式，且区分安抚帖与裁决帖
modern_applications_en: Management documents for remote teams: for the distributed team one cannot reach, write major decisions as three-part documents (situation diagnosis→grounds→bounded directives), choosing the consoling or adjudicating register by what the other side needs—ending the failed management of 'orders without diagnosis'

Written opinions in legal and compliance work: the opinion's authority = the verifiable precision of its grounding; mark each conclusion's boundary of application and expiry, so an opinion is not cited later as a universal clause

Arbitration and announcements in open-source communities and forums: pinned notices in the three-part form (diagnosis of the real structure of the conflict→grounds in the governance charter→time-bounded directives), with consoling and adjudicating posts kept distinct

name_zh: 灵性成长方法论/把对无限者的认识组织为可量化的接近阶梯：每次否定排除一个误认、每级爱或知识把人推近一步，但顶点永远不可抵达——成长被设计为无穷逼近而非一次性跃迁
name_en: spiritual-growth methodology/organize the knowledge of the infinite as a quantifiable ladder of approach: each negation excludes one misidentification, each rung of love or knowledge pushes one rung closer, yet the summit is never reached—growth designed as infinite approximation, not a single leap
category: 灵性成长方法论/把对无限者的认识组织为可量化的接近阶梯：每次否定排除一个误认、每级爱或知识把人推近一步，但顶点永远不可抵达——成长被设计为无穷逼近而非一次性跃迁
modes.domain_zh: 《迷途指津》第三部末章与《密西拿托拉》'忏悔篇'第十章共同承载的方法。迈蒙尼德面对的成长问题是：传统宗教语言把认识上帝描述为一次性事件（见神、得救、开悟），而他的理性框架已把上帝判定为不可被肯定言说——那么'认识上帝'还剩下什么可执行的内容？他的解法是把'认识'重新定义为'渐近'。第一阶梯：知其'不是什么'——每排除一个误认（祂不是物体、不是激情的、不是可比较的），认识就实质推进一级，且这一推进可被验证（排除后的理解不再犯前一级的错误）。第二阶梯：爱之阶梯——'忏悔篇'第十章把对上帝的爱分为'像仆人怕主人的爱'（利益驱动）与'像恋人求恋人的爱'（纯为对象本身）两级，明确命令向第二级爬行，且规定渐进路径：由行为养成情感（'做正确的事，直到做它成为爱'）。第三阶梯：理智阶梯——《迷途指津》末章断言：人的完满是'以理智认识理智的对象'，而对最高对象的认识永在进行中——由此，'灵性成长'被改写为可以终身执行、每级可检验、顶点永远开放的无穷程序。代价与极限：渐近结构缺乏'到达感'，对需要体验性确证的传统（卡巴拉、先知主义）是剥夺——迈蒙尼德之争中神秘主义者对其'干瘪理智主义'的攻击正源于此；且阶梯的级距标准（何谓'排除完成'、何谓'爱升一级'）依赖判断，容易自我高估——他本人以'谦卑修到极低'（M-MAI-005 的例外条款）对冲，但两法的张力真实存在。
modes.domain_en: The method carried jointly by the final chapters of Guide III and Hilkhot Teshuvah chapter ten. Maimonides faced a problem of growth: traditional religious language describes knowing God as a one-time event (vision, salvation, awakening), while his rational frame has already judged God unsayable in positive terms—what executable content remains for 'knowing God'? His solution: redefine knowing as asymptotic approach. Ladder one, knowing what He is not—each excluded misidentification (not a body, not passionate, not comparable) advances knowledge by one verifiable rung (the corrected understanding no longer commits the previous level's error). Ladder two, the ladder of love—Hilkhot Teshuvah 10 divides love of God into 'the servant's love that fears the master' (interest-driven) and 'the lover's love that seeks the beloved' (for the object alone), commands climbing to the second, and prescribes the gradual path: act rightly until acting becomes loving. Ladder three, the ladder of intellect—the Guide's last chapter asserts that man's perfection is 'knowing the intelligible with the intellect,' and that knowledge of the highest object is always in progress—thus 'spiritual growth' is rewritten as an infinite program: executable for a lifetime, testable at each rung, summit forever open. Costs and limits: the asymptotic structure withholds the sense of arrival, and traditions that require experiential confirmation (Kabbalah, prophecy) are stripped by it—the mystics' attack on his 'dry intellectualism' in the Maimonidean controversy stems from exactly here; and the rung-standards (when is an exclusion 'complete,' when has love 'risen a level') rest on judgment and invite self-overestimation—he hedges with 'humility cultivated to the utmost low' (the exception clause of M-MAI-005), but the tension between the two methods is real.
modes.definition_zh: 灵性成长方法论/把'认识上帝'改写为三重渐近阶梯：知其不是（可验证的排除推进）→爱之两级（由利益驱动爬向纯为对象）→理智永进（完满是过程不是到达）——成长是无穷逼近，每级可检验，顶点永远开放
modes.definition_en: Spiritual-growth methodology/rewrite 'knowing God' as a triple asymptotic ladder: knowing what He is not (verifiable advance by exclusion)→two grades of love (climbing from interest-driven to purely object-directed)→the intellect ever advancing (perfection is a process, not an arrival)—growth as infinite approximation, each rung testable, the summit forever open
modes.source_chapter: 《迷途指津》第三部第 51-54 章（末章'以理智认识理智对象'）；《密西拿托拉》'忏悔篇'第十章论两级爱；'德性篇'论爱与认知的互养
key_concepts: 渐近认识 asymptotic knowing（认识被改写为无穷逼近的程序）
排除的推进 advance by exclusion（每排除一个误认即实质一级）
两级之爱 the two grades of love（仆人式利益驱动到恋人式纯为对象）
由行生爱 love born of action（做正确的事直到做它成为爱）
开放顶点 the open summit（完满是过程，到达感被制度性悬置）
modes.key_quote_zh: 认识祂不是一次抵达，而是一条永远在延伸的阶梯——你每排除一个错误的想象，你就真实地升高了一级。
modes.key_quote_en: To know Him is not one arrival but a ladder forever extending—exclude one more false imagining, and you have truly climbed one more rung.
process_zh: 把目标改写为渐近：把'一次性抵达'型目标（认识、觉悟、完美）改写为'可执行的无穷逼近程序'——先确定'接近'在哪些可观察量上体现
设可验证的级距：每一级推进必须对应一个可自检的差分（排除某误认后不再犯前一级错误；行为从利益驱动变为对象驱动）
由行生情排路径：对情感类目标（爱、敬）不直接要求情感，而是规定行为序列——'做正确的事直到做它成为爱'，让行为训练先于情感声明
接受顶点开放并防自我高估：明示完满是过程而非到达，并以谦卑条款对冲级距判断的自我高估——阶梯的诚实性依赖承认'我可能高估了自己所在的级'
process_en: Rewrite the goal as asymptotic: turn 'one-time arrival' goals (knowing, awakening, perfection) into an executable program of infinite approximation—first fixing in which observable quantities 'approach' shows

Set verifiable rung-gaps: each advance must correspond to a self-checkable difference (after excluding a misidentification the previous level's error is no longer made; conduct shifts from interest-driven to object-driven)

Order the path by action before feeling: for emotional targets (love, reverence) do not demand the feeling directly—prescribe the behavioral sequence, 'do the right thing until doing it becomes loving,' letting conduct train ahead of emotional claims

Accept the open summit and guard against self-overestimation: state that perfection is process, not arrival, and hedge the judgment of rung-position with the humility clause—the ladder's honesty depends on admitting 'I may have overestimated my own rung'
representative_cases_zh: 《忏悔篇》第十章的两级爱：把'为什么事奉上帝'从利益动机逐步训练为纯为对象——灵性动机的可执行升级路径
《迷途指津》末章的理智论断：人的完满是'以理智认识理智的对象'——对最高对象的认识永在进行，体系以此收束
与否定属性的配合：每排除一个'上帝是 X'的误认即认识推进一级——否定法（M-MAI-003）为渐近阶梯提供级距刻度
representative_cases_en: The two grades of love in Hilkhot Teshuvah 10: training the motive of serving God from interest to the object alone—an executable upgrade path for spiritual motive
The closing intellectual thesis of the Guide: man's perfection is 'knowing the intelligible with the intellect'—knowledge of the highest object always in progress, the system closing on this
The harness with negative attributes: each excluded 'God is X' advances knowledge one rung—the negative method (M-MAI-003) supplies the rung-scale for the asymptotic ladder
modern_applications_zh: 技能精进的阶梯设计：把'成为专家'改写为'每级差分可自检的无穷逼近'（排除一个误解=真实推进一级），并以行为序列先于状态声明——'先做专家做的事，直到做它成为身份'
长期目标（健康/学习/修行）的动机升级：把动机按'利益驱动→对象驱动'分级训练，承认顶点开放并防自我高估——避免'已开悟'式的自我报告失真
产品质量的渐近哲学：把'完美产品'改写为'每版排除一个误判的渐近序列'——可检验的级距使'更好'不依赖宣称
modern_applications_en: Ladder design for skill mastery: rewrite 'becoming an expert' as infinite approximation with self-checkable per-rung differences (excluding one misunderstanding = one true rung of advance), and let the behavioral sequence precede the status claim—'do what experts do until doing it becomes identity'

Motive upgrade for long-term aims (health, learning, practice): train motives in grades from interest-driven to object-driven, accept the open summit, and guard against self-overestimation—avoiding the distorted self-report of 'I have arrived'
An asymptotic philosophy of product quality: rewrite 'the perfect product' as an asymptotic sequence that excludes one misjudgment per release—verifiable rung-gaps make 'better' independent of claim
related_modes: M-MAI-003（否定的属性法——阶梯的刻度来源：每次否定排除一个误认，为渐近提供可验证的级距）
M-MAI-005（中间道路法——阶梯的张力伙伴：中道的'稳'与渐近的'升'共享可测气质但方向相反，两法的张力由谦卑条款调和）

name_zh: 体系落地方法论/把体系的全部要素收束于一个可模仿的完整人格：法典、信条、哲学、医术最终在'此人如何生活'上被验证——体系的说服力从命题层下移到人格层
name_en: system-landing methodology/gather all elements of a system into one imitable complete person: the code, the creed, the philosophy and the medicine are finally verified in 'how this man lived'—the system's persuasiveness shifting from the propositional to the personal layer
category: 体系落地方法论/把体系的全部要素收束于一个可模仿的完整人格：法典、信条、哲学、医术最终在'此人如何生活'上被验证——体系的说服力从命题层下移到人格层
modes.domain_zh: 迈蒙尼德全部著作与其生平合观所呈现的方法。他的体系有一个通常被忽视的收束设计：法典（怎么活）、信条（信什么）、哲学（怎么想）、医学（怎么维持身体）各自成立，但四者共同指向一个问题——'一个智识人能在流散中完整地生活吗？'迈蒙尼德用自己的一生作答：他既是写出零引注法典的法官，又是写否定神学的哲学家，还是不因安息日中止行医的医师、写信安抚也门的领袖——四重身份在他身上不是并列履历而是互相验证：法典的归拢气质出现在医学的变量清单里，信条的最低共识出现在书信的安抚工程里，而'从摩西到摩西，无人如摩西'的墓志铭把这个人格本身立为体系的最后一条论证。方法的要点：其一，'人格即证明'——体系的可靠性论证不走'命题皆真'的路线，而走'此人已按此体系完整生活过'的路线；其二，'可模仿性'——收束点必须是普通人可部分模仿的生活形态（他的作息、他的兼任、他的取舍被门徒记录为规范），而非不可模仿的神迹；其三，'收束反哺'——人格被立为典范后反向强化体系的各层（后世学徒因敬其人而信其书）。代价与极限：典范收束把体系的命运与一个人的声誉捆绑——迈蒙尼德之争中反对方焚烧其书，正是打击'人格—体系'捆绑体的手段；且典范的人格瑕疵会连带侵蚀体系（他终生未再婚的争议、其父权式裁决风格的批评，都被对手用作体系的反证）；'可模仿性'在跨文化传播中衰减最快——人格一旦被神化（墓志铭的'从摩西到摩西'已含此风险），模仿就被崇拜替代，收束点失效。
modes.domain_en: The method presented by reading Maimonides's works and life together. His system carries a closure-design usually overlooked: the code (how to live), the creed (what to believe), the philosophy (how to think) and the medicine (how to keep the body) each stand, but all four point to one question—'can an intellectual live completely in exile?' Maimonides answered with his own life: the judge who wrote a citation-free code, the philosopher who wrote negative theology, the physician who did not pause practice for the Sabbath, the leader who wrote to console Yemen—the four identities are not a parallel résumé but mutual verification: the gathering temperament of the code appears in the variable-lists of the medicine, the minimal consensus of the creed in the consoling engineering of the letters, and the epitaph 'from Moses to Moses, none like Moses' erects the person himself as the system's final argument. The method's points: first, the person as proof—the reliability of the system argued not via 'the propositions are true' but via 'this man has lived the system completely'; second, imitability—the closure must be a form of life partially imitable by ordinary people (his routine, his simultaneous offices, his trade-offs recorded by disciples as norms), not unimitable miracle; third, closure feeding back—the exemplified person retroactively strengthens every layer of the system (later students believe the books because they revere the man). Costs and limits: exemplar-closure ties the system's fate to one man's reputation—opponents burned his books in the controversy precisely to strike the person-system bundle; and the exemplar's flaws erode the system with them (the controversy over his lifelong remarriage, the criticism of his paternal style of ruling, all used against the system); and imitability decays fastest in cross-cultural transmission—once the person is deified (the epitaph's 'from Moses to Moses' already carries the risk), imitation is replaced by worship and the closure-point fails.
modes.definition_zh: 体系落地方法论/把法典、信条、哲学、医术收束于一个可模仿的完整人格：体系的可靠性论证走'此人已按此体系完整生活'的路线；收束点必须可模仿而非神迹化——人格被神化之日即收束失效之时
modes.definition_en: System-landing methodology/gather code, creed, philosophy and medicine into one imitable complete person: the system's reliability argued via 'this man has lived the system completely'; the closure-point must stay imitable, not deified—the day the person is deified is the day the closure fails
modes.source_chapter: 迈蒙尼德书信集对其多重身份的自述；《密西拿托拉》'德性篇'对智者人格的规范性描述；其墓志铭与门徒记载的生平规范
key_concepts: 人格即证明 the person as proof（'此人已完整生活过'的可靠性路线）
可模仿性 imitability（普通人可部分复制的生活形态）
四重互证 fourfold mutual verification（法典—信条—哲学—医术在同一人身上互相验证）
收束反哺 closure feedback（敬其人而信其书的逆向强化）
神化风险 the deification risk（崇拜替代模仿，收束点失效）
modes.key_quote_zh: 体系最后的论证不在书里，在生活里——若这套生活行不通，写它的那只手也应受审。
modes.key_quote_en: The system's final argument is not in the books but in the life—if this life cannot be lived, the hand that wrote it stands for judgment too.
process_zh: 先建体系的互证结构：让体系的各组成领域（规范、信念、认知、实践）共享同一批方法气质，使它们在同一人身上能互相验证而非各自为政
把人格立为收束点：明确宣布体系的最终验证形式是'一个完整人格的生活'，并以自己的公开实践（可查证的行为记录）作答
守住可模仿性下限：收束人格的生活方式必须普通人在其条件下可部分复制——写明取舍（兼任的代价、拒绝的诱惑），禁止神迹化叙事
预防捆绑风险：预先声明'典范的私德争议不自动构成体系反证'，并把体系的命题层与人格层分开审计——收束一旦失效，命题层仍应可独立检验
process_en: Build the mutual-verification structure first: make the system's constituent fields (norms, beliefs, cognition, practice) share one set of method-temperaments, so they verify one another in a single person instead of going their own ways
Erect the person as closure-point: declare that the system's final form of verification is 'the life of one complete person,' and answer with one's own public practice (verifiable records of conduct)

Hold the floor of imitability: the exemplar's way of life must be partially replicable by ordinary people under their conditions—write down the trade-offs (the cost of holding offices together, the temptations refused), and forbid hagiography

Hedge the bundling risk: state in advance that 'controversies over the exemplar's private conduct do not automatically refute the system,' and audit the propositional and personal layers separately—so even if closure fails, the propositions remain independently testable
representative_cases_zh: 四重身份的互证：法典的归拢气质出现在《养生法》的变量清单，信条的最低共识出现在《也门书信》的安抚工程——同一方法气质贯穿四域
'从摩西到摩西，无人如摩西'的墓志铭：把人格本身立为体系的最后一条论证——典范收束的公共仪式化
安息日行医的公开实践：以可查证的行为（不因仪式中止专业响应）为'专业义务高于仪式义务'作人格层证明
representative_cases_en: The mutual verification of four identities: the gathering temperament of the code reappears in the Regimen's variable-lists, the creed's minimal consensus in the Yemen letter's consoling engineering—one method-temperament across four fields
The epitaph 'from Moses to Moses, none like Moses': the person himself erected as the system's final argument—the public ritualization of exemplar-closure
The public practice of practicing medicine on the Sabbath: a verifiable conduct (no ritual suspends the professional response) as personal-layer proof that professional duty outranks ritual
modern_applications_zh: 创始人型组织的体系落地：把方法论、价值观、产品哲学收束于创始人公开可查证的生活实践（而非口号），同时预先声明'人格争议与命题真伪分开审计'——防止人设崩塌连带摧毁体系
学术传统的师承建制：导师以'可模仿的生活形态'（作息、兼任、取舍）而非神化形象收束学派，并写明取舍代价——模仿可复制，崇拜必失真
公共知识分子的立身设计：主张与其生活互相验证（公开行为记录可查），并为'私德争议不自动构成观点反证'预设辩护边界——既立典范又留审计缝隙
modern_applications_en: System-landing in founder-led organizations: gather methodology, values and product philosophy into the founder's publicly verifiable lived practice rather than slogans, while declaring in advance that 'character controversies and propositional truth are audited separately'—so a persona collapse does not destroy the system

Institution-building in academic lineages: the mentor closes the school as 'an imitable form of life' (routine, offices held, trade-offs made) rather than a deified image, with the costs written down—imitation replicates, worship distorts

Self-design for public intellectuals: let claims and life verify one another (public records of conduct checkable), while pre-setting the boundary that 'private-conduct controversies do not automatically refute the ideas'—raising an exemplar while leaving an audit seam
related_modes: M-MAI-001（公理化归拢法——收束的内部结构：四域共享的归拢气质是人格互证得以成立的前提）
